name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 to deliver 11,850 impressions, 150 clicks, and 5 leads at a cost per lead of $43.90.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads of the day on $153.40 spend, with a click rate of 1.4% and cost per lead of $30.68 — the stronger performer on both counts.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate but brought no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $487.00 with 28 days left in 2026-11.
The mature 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) shows a hire rate of 12.5% and a contact rate of 90.0%, both running ahead of the 2026-09-21 cohort, which sits at 10.5% hired and 86.8% contacted.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — but it is too young to judge its rates.
